summary.text: Carrie Woerner is the incumbent Democratic candidate for New York State Assembly District 113 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former software executive, she was first elected to the Assembly in 2014 and chairs the Committee on Racing and Wagering.

paragraphs.text: Woerner earned an undergraduate degree from Carnegie-Mellon University and an MBA from Santa Clara University.

According to her official biography, she began a 30-year career in software and technical writing at firms such as Dell/Perot Systems and IBM, and in 2008 established a software division in Saratoga Springs for The Wall Street Transcript, where she was vice president and general manager of MeetMax Conference Software.
Woerner was elected to the Assembly in November 2014 and is now in her sixth term.

She chairs the Committee on Racing and Wagering and is a member of the Agriculture, Local Governments, and Tourism, Parks, Arts and Sports Development committees; she also chairs the Legislative Women's Caucus.

Her official biography says she has passed 85 bills in the Assembly since 2015, 65 of which were signed into law, and that she focuses on responsible spending, small businesses and farms, and public schools.
